definition: שִׁדָּה noun feminine meaning unknown; — only singular and plural שִׁדָּה וְשִׁדּוֺת Eccl 2:8 , apparently appositive of תַּעֲנגֻוֺת ( ᵐ5 οἰνοχόον καὶ οἰνοχόας , i.e. שֹׁדֶה וְשֹׁדוֺת , from Aramaic שְׁדָא pour out [but not spec. of wine]; Aq κυλίκιον καὶ κυλίκια (compare ᵑ9 ), probably from same √; Dl Prol. 97 Kö ii. 1. 161 Wild Siegf compare Assyrian šadâdu , love ( Siegf 'Haremsperlen'), but this word lacks evidence; possibly שָׂרָה וְשָׁרוֺת , see I. שָׂרָה
